name: SDN Peers Discovery Flow
description: Gateway peers flow (mount GET /api/v1/peers[/{peerId}]): foundation/http-route discover decides the request as an $APR (peers_list / peer_get + peerId); hostcap/p2p-discovery peers_snapshot reads the host's peerstore through the policy-mediated p2p.peers_snapshot hostcall (typed $PIV, capability p2p_read) and answers an $NST (identity fields decoded from each peer's stored $EPM) beside the $APR (STATUS 404 peer-unknown, 502 host-failed); foundation/http-respond respond renders the $HTR: the $NST verbatim as FlatBuffers by default, JSON on request. foundation/discovery-shape is no longer in the graph: the typed $NST is the shaped answer. Typed contracts 1.0: every edge carries one SDS FlatBuffers type; no JSON travels between nodes (JSON exists only as the client representation http-respond renders on request).

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Peer and standards discovery served by the G.2 gateway flows (wasm; routing, format selection and ETag logic run inside the module; snapshots come from the policy-mediated p2p_read capability).

routes.summary: Known peers with EPM profiles and published standards
routes.description: The peers this node knows (SDS Node Status Record): per peer its identity fields from the stored $EPM (DN, ORGANIZATION, keys), addresses, agent version, online state and whether it is this node; /{peerId} narrows to one peer. Representation: FlatBuffers by default (?format=flatbuffer or Accept: application/x-flatbuffers); ?format=json or Accept: application/json renders the same record as JSON with the standard's IDL field names (enums by name, byte vectors hex) - rendered by foundation/http-respond, the only place JSON exists. Conditional GET: the record's ETAG (a content tag, stable across calls while the content is unchanged) rides the etag header; If-None-Match equal to it answers 304.

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding: flatbuffer = aligned size-prefixed $EPM FlatBuffer stream (default), json = bare JSON array of peer records.

200.description: One $NST. Representation: FlatBuffers by default (?format=flatbuffer or Accept: application/x-flatbuffers); ?format=json or Accept: application/json renders the same record as JSON with the standard's IDL field names (enums by name, byte vectors hex) - rendered by foundation/http-respond, the only place JSON exists.

schema.description: $NST (SDS NST.fbs): The peers this node knows (SDS Node Status Record): per peer its identity fields from the stored $EPM (DN, ORGANIZATION, keys), addresses, agent version, online state and whether it is this node; /{peerId} narrows to one peer.

304.description: Not modified: If-None-Match equals the record's ETAG.

404.description: No route, or (/{peerId}) a peer unknown to this node (peer-unknown).
